storyline.real: Häkkinen leads the first 46 laps with Coulthard behind, until Ferrari put Schumacher on three stops to McLaren's two. He builds a lead big enough to keep after his third stop and wins by 9.4 s from Coulthard.
storyline.headline: Coulthard answers Ferrari's three stops in Budapest

hidden.label: Win without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Hungaroring, 1998. Häkkinen on pole, Coulthard beside him, Schumacher third. You run Coulthard, second after 22 laps with Schumacher 0.7 s behind. Win it.
